title: Vocabularies and Token IDs
learning_objectives: Build a vocabulary with reserved special tokens
Encode text to integer IDs with an unknown-token fallback and decode it back
Pad a batch of sequences and build its attention mask
entry_point: build_vocab(texts, min_count=1); encode(text, vocab, add_special=True); decode(ids, vocab, skip_special=True); pad_batch(seqs, pad_id=0)
hints: `counts = Counter(tok for t in texts for tok in t.lower().split())`; sort items with `key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0])`.
`vocab.get(tok, vocab["<unk>"])`; decode with an inverse dict `{i: t for t, i in vocab.items()}`.
`L = max(len(s) for s in seqs)` (0 for an empty batch); `s + [pad_id] * (L - len(s))` and `[1] * len(s) + [0] * (L - len(s))`.

failure_feedback.advice: Put the four specials first, then sort tokens by count descending and alphabetically.
Skip tokens whose count is below `min_count`.
Lowercase, map unknown tokens to `<unk>` and wrap with `<bos>`/`<eos>`.
Invert the vocabulary for decoding and drop special tokens only when asked.
Pad on the right to the longest sequence; the mask is 1 for real tokens.
